A scatterplot titled 'Scatterplot' showing the relationship between variables x and y. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 8 with increments of 1, labeled 'x'. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 60 with increments of 10, labeled 'y'. Nine data points are plotted at approximately: (0, 13), (1, 14), (2, 15), (3, 17), (4, 20), (5, 23), (6, 28), (7, 34), (8, 43). The scatterplot shows exponential growth with a horizontal asymptote around y = 12, visible as the data points on the left side level off near this value. The pattern follows the model y = 8(1.4)^(x-4) + 12.
